parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF with a smooth finish and a metal handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling swinging motion for opening and closing.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is an internal shelf made of plywood, providing horizontal support for stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet interior into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower internal shelf made of plywood, supporting heavier items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and structural support to the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the overall shape, rigidity, and support for the door, shelves, and base.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom base panel of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the entire cabinet and the stored items, ensuring stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
